summary: Tested Before/After Preview and Undo for AI-suggested improvements feature. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: 4 steps in edit mode header (Selecionar, Análise, Preview, Resultado), PreviewPanel with before/after comparison, EditResultPanel with Undo button, cancel preview returns to analysis step, undo restores course and returns to course selection.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: preview-improvements endpoint correctly generates before/after comparison data with previewId
GOOD: apply-improvements accepts previewId to use cached AI result, avoiding duplicate AI calls
GOOD: Course snapshot saved before applying improvements for undo functionality
GOOD: undo-improvements correctly restores course from snapshot and deletes snapshot after use
GOOD: PreviewPanel component shows clear before/after comparison with ANTES/DEPOIS labels
GOOD: EditResultPanel shows canUndo=true and displays Undo button when snapshot exists
GOOD: Cancel preview returns to analysis step (step 1) as expected
GOOD: EDIT_STEPS updated to 4 steps: Selecionar, Análise, Preview, Resultado
seed_data_creation: Used existing agent-created courses for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Before/After Preview and Undo feature is fully implemented and working. Key endpoints: POST /api/agent/courses/{id}/preview-improvements (returns previewId, comparisons, updatedCount, newCount), POST /api/agent/courses/{id}/apply-improvements (accepts previewId, creates snapshot for undo), POST /api/agent/courses/{id}/undo-improvements (restores from snapshot). Frontend: EDIT_STEPS has 4 steps, PreviewPanel shows before/after, EditResultPanel has Undo button. MongoDB collections: improvement_previews (caches AI results), course_snapshots (stores original course for undo).
